title: Game configuration — config/game-config.json
description: Root configuration of one generated slot game: identity and versioning, grid geometry, win-evaluation mode, bet configuration in integer minor units, max-win cap, RTP profiles, and references to the sibling config files that complete the game definition.

gameId.description: Stable machine id of the game (kebab-case). Usually equals projectSlug, optionally suffixed for market variants.

gameName.description: Public display name of the game.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case slug of the generated project directory games/<slug>/.

gameVersion.description: Semver of the overall game package (client + configs).

mathVersion.description: Semver of the math model. Bumped whenever any math-relevant config changes.

configHash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON concatenation of all config/*.json in filename alphabetical order (UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace).

grid.description: Reel grid geometry. Exactly one of rows (uniform) or rowsPerReel (variable) must be present.

columns.description: Number of reels (columns), left to right.

rows.description: Visible rows when every reel shows the same number of rows.

rowsPerReel.description: Visible rows per reel, left to right; length must equal columns (enforced by the config validator).

winEvaluation.description: How wins are evaluated on the grid.

mode.description: Win-evaluation archetype: fixed paylines, all-ways adjacency, cluster pays, or pays-anywhere count thresholds (scatter_pays, v1.0.1 widening).

lineCount.description: Number of fixed paylines. Required by the config validator when mode is "lines"; ignored otherwise.

minClusterSize.description: Smallest paying cluster size. Only meaningful when mode is "cluster".

bet.description: Bet configuration. All amounts are integer minor units of defaultCurrency; never binary floats.

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the bet levels are denominated in.

minBetMinor.description: Smallest total bet in minor units (e.g. 10 = 0.10).

maxBetMinor.description: Largest total bet in minor units (e.g. 10000 = 100.00). Must be >= minBetMinor (config validator).

betLevelsMinor.description: Selectable total-bet levels in minor units, ascending; first must equal minBetMinor and last maxBetMinor (config validator).

items.description: One selectable total bet in minor units.

defaultBetMinor.description: Bet pre-selected at load; must be a member of betLevelsMinor (config validator).

maxWinXBet.description: Hard maximum win cap as a whole-number multiple of total bet. Enforced in math and engine via the max_win_termination step.

rtpProfiles.description: All RTP profiles this game ships with. Exactly one profile must have default true (config validator).

targetRtp.description: Target RTP fraction of this profile.

default.description: Whether this profile is the shipped default.

reelSetSuffix.description: Optional suffix distinguishing this profile's reel sets (e.g. "-94").

configFileRefs.description: Filenames of the sibling files in config/ that complete the game definition. Paths are relative to config/; each must validate against its schema.

bonusBuys.description: Bonus-buy modes (bonus-buys.json); omit when bonus buy is not built.

autoplay.description: Autoplay settings (autoplay.json); omit when autoplay is not built.

configFileName.description: Kebab-case JSON filename relative to config/.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

minorUnitsPositive.description: Strictly positive monetary amount in integer minor units.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
